[{"id":"tmw0j8lh7zjxn","type":"consommables","title":"aaaaaaa","cover":"","machine":"","text":"","url":""},{"id":"tmvtathpvmfte","type":"presentation","title":"aa","cover":"","machine":"","text":"","url":"","file":null},{"id":"tmvrupcvaygtl","type":"constructeur","title":"zz","cover":"","machine":"","text":"","url":""},{"id":"f1","type":"presentation","title":"Principe du trieur optique verre","machine":"Tous trieurs","url":"","text":"Le verre broyé (calcin) est étalé en nappe fine sur un convoyeur ou une goulotte.
